children: Canadian housing starts fell short of expectations in August, data from the national housing agency showed on Wednesday.

The seasonally adjusted annualized rate of housing starts edged down to 229,046 units from a revised 229,360 units in July, the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation said. Economists had expected starts to rise to 240,000.
